g.title: BTCML
g.text: Release 071126 · installed-source model · 08 November 2026 · Source/edge index accompanies this SVG
PAPER is simulated execution. Market observation, technical health and entry permission are distinct.
DATA: teal solid | CONTROL/GUARD: amber dashed | HEALTH/OBSERVATION: gray dotted | STORED STATE: green | FUTURE: purple, no runtime edge

g.title: cluster_btcml
g.text: BTC-ML SYSTEM BOUNDARY · FOURTEEN SERVICES · PAPER ONLY

g.title: spot
g.text: SOURCE: feed, Spot transport, Intrabar Cognition

g.title: system
g.text: INPUT: Spot + Futures; original source clocks
OUTPUT: Owned generations, commands, PAPER state

g.title: state
g.text: WORK: Original IDs, availability and provenance
OUTPUT: Private volumes + bound R08 runtime
SOURCE: Recorder storage, Journal V3, Financial authority

g.title: system->state
g.text: durable RAW; Parquet / JSON / Journal V3

g.title: monitor
g.text: INPUT: Owner publications and process status
WORK: Read-only projections; no fabricated trade

g.title: paper
g.text: INPUT: Admitted commands and genuine market
WORK: Risk / costs / positions / SL / TP / CLOSE
SOURCE: Paper engine, Risk/economics, Financial authority

g.title: real
g.text: WORK: No REAL route activated by this task

g.title: operator
g.text: INPUT: Dashboard / Chart / technical API views
